description: Wearing an elytra, glide east from 20 blocks up and die (/kill) mid-glide: the server ends the glide as the player dies, the body falls, and 20 ticks after dying the client takes it out of the level in mid-air, where it stops; respawn once the death screen's buttons work, back at the spawn point (4 -60 4), and walk.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

build: item replace entity @a armor.chest with minecraft:elytra
harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
